Rep bar shows that a thruster is under recovery, once 100% you regain the functionality and HPs.

Dash bar shows how much hyper accelaration remains
Thruster status, when an arrow is blinking the ship cannot move in that direction

<- The BAKUNIN IV, your spaceship!

W-A-S-D to move the ship
Left Click for fire
Right Click + W-A-S-D to hyper accelerate

Every time you get hit, the ship loses HPs and a thruster or fire goes out of work

The galaxy is under the ruthless control of a tyrannical government.
     
     
You are the last hope, a fearless smuggler defying their grip, delivering vital goods to ignite the uprising across the stars.
     
     
But your cover is blown. The Government fleet is on your tail, hunting you down with relentless force.
     
     
Your only chance? Dive into the asteroid belt, vanish into the shadows, and outsmart their pursuit.
     
     
Gear up, pilot. The fight for freedom begins now. Good luck...and let the beats of *IL-TRITA-CARNE* fuel your rebellion!
You left the bloody pigs behind, well done!
They have been lying in wait beyond the asteroid belt. Now, the entire Government division stands against you. Brace yourself for an all-out, furious battle!
You have slipped through the Admirals grasp, you delivered the precious goods to people. Now it is time to celebrate!
